answer: Time-locked collateral escrow resists Sybil attacks without turning an agent network into a walled garden. Each key locks a minimum refundable bond in an epoch smart contract, while watchers spot equivocation like a falcon to slash fraud. Because deposits cannot back concurrent keys, attackers incur the verifiable cost of locked liquid capital and foregone yield per identity. Yet even when rules bind with ferrous rigidity, wealthy actors can still finance bulk fake accounts.
